reason: The README describes an agent tool whose primary purpose is rendering Mermaid diagram source into SVG images for display in responses, with optional local HTTP hosting and data URI fallback.

summaries.zh: 将 Mermaid 图表源码渲染为可嵌入回答的 SVG 图片，并提供原始 SVG、数据 URI 及可选的本地访问地址。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid diagram source into embeddable SVG images and returns the raw SVG, a data URI, and optionally a local access URL.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid diagram source into SVG
Returns raw SVG and a data URI for embedding
Can expose rendered SVG through a local HTTP route when a web server is available
Reports Mermaid parsing errors with diagnostic details
